ssl-https-http.title: Kerekere e cala
ssl-https-http.description: E rawa ni curumi na mataveilawa oqo ena HTTPS. O a tovolea mo sema ena HTTP, ka keitou na tovolea oqo me keitou vagolei iko tale. Kevaka o sega ni vagolei tale, yalovinaka kuria na https:// ena itekitekivu ni nomu URL ka tovolea tale.

ssl-insecure.title: Kerekere e sega ni taqomaki

maintenance.title: E sega ni sema tiko ena vuku ni cakacaka ni vakavinakataki
